1: Allah raat ki qasam khata hai jab woh apni tareeki se aasmanon aur zameen ke darmiyan ki har cheez ko dhanp leti hai.
2: Aur Allah din ki qasam khata hai jab woh wazeh aur zahir ho jata hai.
3: Aur woh apne do sinf, yani mard aur aurat paida karne ki qasam khata hai.
4: Aey logon, tumhare aamaal mukhtalif hain: kuch neik hain, jo jannat mein daakhil hone ka sabab bante hain, aur kuch bure hain, jo jahannum mein daakhil hone ka sabab bante hain.
5: Pas jis ne woh kuch diya jo us par kharch karna zaroori tha, yani zakaat, nafqa aur tawan, aur un cheezon se bacha jin se Allah ne usey roka,
6: aur us badle par iman laya jis ka Allah ne us se wada kiya,
7: main bahut jald us ke liye neik aamaal karna aur apne raaste mein kharch karna aasan kar doonga.
8: Aur jis ne apne maal mein bakheeli ki aur usey un jaghon par kharch na kiya jahan kharch karna us par zaroori tha, aur apne aap ko Allah se be-niyaz samjha aur us se us ke fazl ka sawal na kiya,
9: aur us badle aur ajr ka inkaar kiya jis ka Allah ne us se wada kiya tha agar woh apna maal us ke raaste mein kharch kare,
10: main bahut jald us ke liye bure aamaal karna aasan kar doonga aur bhalai karna mushkil.
11: Jis maal mein woh bakheeli karta hai, woh usey zara faida na dega jab woh mar kar jahannum mein daakhil hoga.
12: Beshak haqq ka raasta batil ke raaste se wazeh karna meri zimmedari hai.
13: Aur beshak aakhirat aur duniya ki zindagi meri hai; main is mein jo chahta hoon karta hoon. Kisi aur ke liye yeh baat nahin.
14: Pas aey logon, agar tum meri nafarmani karo, to main tumhein us jahannum se darata hoon jo bhadkai ja rahi hai.
15: Is aag ki garmi sirf wohi uthayega jo sab se bad-bakht hai, yani kafir,
16: jis ne us cheez ko jhutlaya jo Rasool ﷺ laaye, aur Allah ke hukm ko poora karne se munh pher liya.
17: Aur logon mein sab se zyada Allah se darne wala us se door rakha jayega, yani Abu Bakr.
18: Wohi jo apna maal neik jaghon par kharch karta hai, taake apne aap ko gunahon se paak kare.
19: Woh jo maal kharch karta hai, kisi ke kiye hue ehsan ka badla dene ke liye nahin kharch karta.
20: Apne kharch se woh sirf apne Rubb ki razamandi chahta hai, jo apni makhlooq se buland hai.
21: Aur beshak woh bahut jald us karam-naak ajr par raazi ho jayega jo Allah usey dega.
